cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW871, from Beijing to London, you are at stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是英航871，从北京飞往伦敦，你现在在215号停机位，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, BAW871, stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，英航871，215号停机位，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。

cards.audioText: BAW871, cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK 05D Departure, initially 900m on 1023, cruising level 10,400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，按照VYK05离场程序，初始爬升至900米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10400米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK 05D Departure, initially 900m on 1023, cruising level 10,400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，按照VYK05离场程序，初始爬升至900米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10400米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523，英航871。

cards.audioText: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，英航871，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: BAW871, Push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，同意推出开车，面朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝西，英航871。

cards.audioText: You noticed the tug is not in position yet, ask Ground control for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: 你注意到拖车未就位，向地面管制请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，英航871，请求拖车。

cards.audioText:
BAW871, roger, the tug is on the way.
While taxiing, you notices the wind sock shows a strong tail wind, contact Ground to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh:
英航871，收到，拖车在路上。
滑行过程中，你注意到风袋显示强顺风，联系地面，检查风向风速。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，英航871，请求风向风速。

cards.audioText: BAW871, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact tower to change to runway 22 and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 顺风量超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台，更换为跑道22, 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW871, the tailwind exceeds takeoff limit, request change to runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航871，顺风量超过起飞限制，请求更换为跑道22。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你飞入鸟群，你左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，英航871，我们我们遭遇鸟击，左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: BAW871, roger your pan, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，收到Pan，右转航向240，切LKO030向台径向线，爬升至3300米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300m, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切LKO030向台径向线，爬升至3300米，英航871。

cards.audioText: BAW871, after LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300m, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，LKO之后，右转航向220，保持3300米，过LKO报。
cards.referenceText: After LKO, turn right heading 220, maintaining 3300m, report over LKO/wilco, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO之后，右转航向220，保持3300米，过LKO报/照办，英航871。

cards.audioText: Now you finished fuel dumping, ask for radar vectors to runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你完成了放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW871, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector to runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，英航871，完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: BAW871, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计使用跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 22, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计使用跑道22，英航871。

cards.audioText: Your APU has failed, tell this situation to Beijing Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的APU失效了，将情况告知北京塔台，请求地面动力装置。
cards.referenceText: Beiing Tower, BAW871, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航871，由于APU失效，请求地面动力装置。

cards.audioText: BAW871, ground power will be ready, caution crosswind when landing, expect ZF-01 arrival, cleared to land, runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，地面电源将就绪，着陆时注意侧风，预计ZF-01进场，可以落地，跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Thanks for caution, ZF-01 arrival, cleared to land, runway 22, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢提示，ZF-01进场，可以落地，跑道22，英航871。
